rules.statement: A judgment-debtor who has fraudulently conveyed property can be cited as a party defendant in an action under section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code to set aside the fraudulent conveyance.
rules.supporting_quote: "I, therefore, can see no reason under the Civil Procedure Code why a claim to set aside the deed might not be added to the plaint in an action under section 247, or be pleaded in the answer in reconvention"
